This 2018 Kia Stinger GT represents a purposeful choice for the driver who values performance, technology, and refined comfort in a single vehicle.

Powered by a 3.3L V6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, this Stinger delivers capable performance with 17 city and 25 highway miles per gallon. The advanced driver assistance system package equips this vehicle with technologies designed to support safer driving, including smart cruise control with stop-and-go capability, lane keeping assist, forward collision avoidance, blind spot collision warning, and rear cross-traffic collision warning. These systems work together to help you stay aware and confident on every journey.

The interior combines luxury with practicality. Heated front bucket seats wrapped in leather provide comfort during morning commutes and winter drives. Dual-zone automatic climate control ensures both driver and passenger can set their preferred temperature independently, while rear climate control extends comfort to back-seat passengers. The sport steering wheel offers responsive control, and telescoping adjustment allows you to find your ideal driving position.

Modern connectivity meets audio excellence in this Stinger. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keep you connected to your smartphone seamlessly, while a nine-speaker SiriusXM audio system delivers rich sound quality. Speed-sensitive wipers and auto rain-sensing capability add convenience features that respond to driving conditions automatically.

The white exterior finish enhances the vehicle's athletic stance, while 19-inch alloy wheels provide a balanced blend of style and capability. Heated door mirrors with compass and HomeLink functionality add practical touches to daily driving, and exterior parking camera rear visibility assists with maneuvering and parking awareness.

This 2018 Stinger GT arrives with 53,933 miles on the odometer and stands ready to provide years of reliable performance to its next owner.

Front and rear parking sensors help prevent collisions, while the regenerative braking system optimizes energy use and extends range. Whether navigating city streets or streaming your favorite music, this Tesla’s tech suite keeps you connected and entertained. 2018 Tesla Model 3 Performance Features The Model 3 Long Range Battery offers an impressive 310 miles per charge, thanks to its lithium-ion battery pack. Recharging on a 240V outlet takes approximately 10 hours, making overnight charging convenient. The vehicle’s full-time all-wheel-drive system ensures optimal traction and stability in various conditions. The four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering provide confidence through curves and during highway driving.The Premium Plus trim focuses on substantive comfort and technology. Dual-zone automatic climate control maintains individual preferences for driver and passenger. Memory seat function recalls your preferred driving position. The steering wheel adjusts both telescopically and for tilt, accommodating various driver heights and preferences.The cabin demonstrates quality engineering throughout. Heated front seats and rear air conditioning ensure comfort across seasons. The leather shift knob and leather steering wheel provide tactile reminders of the S4's premium positioning. HomeLink garage door integration and an overhead console with compass enhance everyday convenience.Technology integration simplifies smartphone connectivity. The Audi MMI Navigation Plus system provides turn-by-turn guidance with over-the-air map updates through the navigation package. The virtual cockpit transforms the instrument cluster into a customizable information display, allowing you to prioritize content that matters most during your drive.This S4 has passed a rigorous safety inspection by a certified technician, ensuring mechanical and safety systems meet exacting standards. The combination of performance capability, premium features, and proven reliability makes this an excellent choice for the discerning driver seeking a balanced sedan.

This 2018 Lexus GS 350 in silver delivers refined performance and sophisticated comfort for the discerning driver who values quality and reliability.

- Lexus Premium AM/FM/DVD/HD Audio System with 12 speakers
- Navigation System
- Power moonroof
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with memory function
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Exterior parking camera rear
- Preferred Accessory Package including carpet trunk mat and alloy wheel locks
- All-wheel drive with 3.5L V6 engine
- 6-Speed automatic transmission with sequential shift
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Dual front and side impact airbags with knee airbag
- 4-wheel disc ABS brakes with brake assist
- Rain-sensing wipers
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- HomeLink garage door transmitter

The GS 350 combines practical engineering with elegant design. Its all-wheel-drive system provides confident handling in any weather condition, while the responsive 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission delivers a balanced driving experience with 19 city and 26 highway MPG. The vehicle's independent suspension and speed-sensing steering contribute to smooth, controlled handling on both highway and local roads.

Inside, the cabin reflects Lexus craftsmanship with genuine wood trim throughout the dashboard, door panels, and console. Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with power adjustment and memory settings ensure comfort during every journey. The dual-zone automatic climate control allows driver and passenger to set individual temperature preferences, while the power moonroof adds an open-air dimension to your drives.

Technology integration enhances convenience and safety. The navigation system guides you efficiently, the HD audio system delivers premium sound quality, and the rearview camera provides added visibility when reversing. The remote keyless entry, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, and HomeLink garage door transmitter keep essential functions at your fingertips.

Safety features throughout this sedan work together to protect occupants. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, 4-wheel disc brakes, and multiple airbags form a comprehensive protective system. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and an emergency communication system add layers of security for your peace of mind.

This GS 350 represents the balance of luxury, reliability, and performance that owners expect from the Lexus brand. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience how this sedan responds to your driving preferences.

The 2018 BMW 430i Gran Coupe combines the athletic driving dynamics of the legendary 3 Series with the sleek styling of a coupe and the everyday practicality of a hatchback. It is one of BMW's most versatile designs, delivering engaging performance, premium craftsmanship, and surprising cargo flexibility without sacrificing the elegant proportions that make the 4 Series so distinctive. While competitors such as the Audi A5 Sportback, Mercedes-Benz C-Class Coupe, Lexus IS, Acura TLX, and Infiniti Q50 each offer their own take on compact luxury, the 430i Gran Coupe stands apart by combining true sports-sedan dynamics with the versatility of a large rear liftgate. It provides the style buyers want with the practicality they often didn't know they needed. Professional reviewers consistently praised the 430i Gran Coupe for its balanced chassis, refined turbocharged engine, upscale cabin, and unique blend of luxury, performance, and everyday usability. Many considered it one of the hidden gems in BMW's lineup thanks to its rare combination of elegance and practicality. Car and Driver ''10Best'' (4 Series generation recognition) Car and Driver ''Editors' Choice'' Widely praised for its outstanding driving dynamics and premium interior Recognized for successfully blending coupe styling with hatchback versatility With its odometer hovering around the 79,865-mile mark, it has a long way to go! Want to extend its warranty coverage? In most cases, we can provide expanded options to cover each vehicle with a valuable, comprehensive warranty for years to come! This 430i Gran Coupe includes several desirable factory upgrades that further enhance its luxury and convenience. Essentials Package Comfort Access Keyless Entry Lets you unlock and start the vehicle without removing the key from your pocket. Park Distance Control Makes parking and maneuvering in tight spaces considerably easier. SiriusXM Satellite Radio Expands entertainment choices (may require subscription). Additional Factory Features Glacier Silver Metallic Paint A timeless metallic finish that perfectly complements the Gran Coupe's elegant body lines. Black Sensatec Leatherette Upholstery with Contrast Stitching Provides a premium appearance while offering excellent durability and everyday comfort. The 430i Gran Coupe successfully blends premium luxury, engaging performance, sophisticated technology, and exceptional everyday practicality into one beautifully balanced sports luxury car. Power comes from BMW's responsive 2.0-liter TwinPower Turbo four-cylinder engine producing 248 horsepower, paired with a smooth and responsive 8-speed Sport Automatic transmission driving the rear wheels. The result is brisk acceleration, impressive fuel efficiency, balanced weight distribution, and the engaging driving character that has long defined BMW's reputation. BMW's finely tuned suspension, precise steering, and near-perfect chassis balance give the 430i Gran Coupe a composed, athletic personality that feels equally at home navigating city streets, winding back roads, or comfortably covering long highway distances. The Gran Coupe's sleek fastback profile is one of its defining features. Unlike a traditional sedan, the large rear liftgate provides dramatically improved cargo access while maintaining elegant coupe-inspired styling. Glacier Silver Metallic paint, LED lighting, signature kidney grilles, and athletic proportions create a timeless appearance that continues to look modern today. Inside, the cabin surrounds occupants with high-quality materials, supportive seating for five, Black Sensatec upholstery with contrast stitching, dual-zone automatic climate control, and the excellent driving position BMW enthusiasts appreciate. The versatile liftback cargo area greatly expands luggage and cargo capacity compared to a traditional trunk. description: This 2015 Audi S3 Quattro is exactly the kind of driver's car enthusiasts spend months trying to find. Finished in the absolutely stunning black exterior over the incredibly rare red leather interior, this S3 has the perfect color combination to match its aggressive personality. The contrast between the deep black exterior, the factory Black Optic 19-inch Audi Sport wheels, and the rich red leather cabin gives this car an exotic, almost supercar-like feel every time you walk up to it. Add in Audi's legendary Quattro all-wheel drive, the flat-bottom S steering wheel, incredible exhaust note, and razor-sharp handling, and it's easy to see why the S3 has become one of the most respected compact sport sedans ever built. This is a lifelong California vehicle with a no-accident history, and in our opinion, one of the cleanest and best-looking S3s on the market today.One of the biggest highlights of this S3 is the factory 19-inch Black Optic Audi Sport wheel package. These are, without question, our favorite wheels ever offered on the S3. The high-gloss black finish perfectly complements the black exterior while tying in beautifully with the rest of the vehicle's factory black accents. They completely transform the stance of the car, fill the wheel wells perfectly, and give the S3 an aggressive appearance that immediately separates it from the standard A3.The S3 is one of those rare cars that feels special every single time you drive it. The turbocharged engine delivers instant acceleration, the exhaust has an incredible sporty tone without being overwhelming, and the Quattro all-wheel-drive system puts the power to the pavement with confidence in virtually every condition. Whether you're accelerating onto the freeway, carving through mountain roads, or simply enjoying your daily commute, this is one of those cars that constantly reminds you why Audi's performance division has such a loyal following.The flat-bottom S steering wheel is another one of our absolute favorite features. The thicker grip, premium leather, aluminum paddle shifters, and sport-inspired design immediately remind you that you're sitting in something much more special than a standard luxury sedan. Every input feels direct, connected, and confidence-inspiring.Inside, the red leather sport seats completely transform the cabin. The rich red leather creates a striking contrast against the black dashboard and interior trim, giving the cabin an upscale European sports car feel. The power seat option allows you to dial in the perfect driving position, making long road trips just as comfortable as spirited weekend drives.The Driver Assistance Package adds several of Audi's most desirable safety technologies, including Audi Side Assist, Lane Change Assist, front and rear acoustic parking sensors, and the parking system with rearview camera. These systems quietly work in the background to make everyday driving easier while providing additional confidence in traffic and tight parking situations.The Audi MMI Navigation Plus with MMI Touch system remains one of the cleanest and most intuitive infotainment systems Audi has ever produced. The navigation system is fast and easy to use, while the MMI Touch controller allows you to quickly access functions without taking your attention away from the road.Although we don't heavily advertise the Premium Plus trim itself, this car includes all of the equipment buyers actually want. Features include the upgraded xenon LED signature lighting, premium interior finishes, heated front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, power driver's seat, backup camera, Bluetooth connectivity, panoramic-style power sunroof, premium sound system, keyless ignition, rain-sensing wipers, auto-dimming mirrors, and Audi's outstanding build quality throughout the cabin.Audi's Quattro all-wheel-drive system is still one of the benchmarks in the automotive industry. It constantly distributes power to the wheels with the most available traction, giving the S3 incredible confidence in rain, snow, and spirited driving while preserving the balanced handling Audi performance cars are known for.One of the biggest reasons we love this particular S3 is its history. A lifelong California vehicle with a no-accident record is exactly the type of performance car we search for. California ownership typically means cleaner undercarriages, less exposure to harsh weather, and owners who simply take excellent care of their vehicles.When you combine the no-accident California history, black exterior, rare red leather interior, factory 19-inch Black Optic Audi Sport wheels, Quattro all-wheel drive, Driver Assistance Package, Audi MMI Navigation Plus with MMI Touch, flat-bottom S steering wheel, incredible exhaust note, and exceptional overall condition, you end up with one of the nicest 2015 Audi S3s available anywhere. This is a true enthusiast's car, and one we're incredibly proud to offer here at Supreme Motors. This 2015 Ford Taurus SEL represents a practical and well-equipped midsize sedan ready to serve your daily driving needs with reliability and comfort.

Parking is simplified with the rear camera and sensors, while the intelligent access system lets you unlock and start the car with a key fob or push button.

Whether you need a capable sedan for your commute or a versatile vehicle for weekend travel, this Taurus SEL provides the features and space you expect from a midsize model. The combination of proven reliability, practical features, and solid construction makes this a sound choice for your next vehicle.

The exterior parking camera and rear parking sensors make maneuvering straightforward and secure. Multiple airbags, including side-impact and knee protection, surround occupants with multiple layers of protection.

This Fusion Hybrid SE represents smart automotive value—a fuel-efficient sedan with thoughtful engineering, modern conveniences, and genuine utility for work commutes, family errands, or weekend travel. This 2019 Nissan Sentra SV offers dependable transportation with a refined blend of efficiency, comfort, and practical features designed for everyday driving.

- Automatic temperature control
- Remote keyless entry

- Fully automatic headlights

- Electronic stability control
- Rear USB ports
- Split folding rear seat
- Power windows and door mirrors

Under the hood sits a 1.8L 4-cylinder engine paired with Nissan's Xtronic CVT transmission, delivering a balanced combination of city driving capability and highway efficiency. The front-wheel-drive configuration provides confident handling across various road conditions, while the engine achieves 29 MPG in the city and 37 MPG on the highway, making this sedan an economical choice for your daily commute and weekend excursions.

The Sentra SV prioritizes your comfort and convenience with dual-zone automatic climate control, keeping front passengers at their preferred temperatures independently. The cabin features premium cloth seating with a 6-way adjustable driver's seat, ensuring you find your ideal driving position. Power windows, door mirrors, and a telescoping steering wheel allow for personalized adjustments, while remote keyless entry provides easy access to your vehicle.

Technology features enhance your driving experience with steering wheel-mounted audio controls, allowing you to manage your music and calls without taking your hands off the wheel. The exterior parking camera offers added confidence when backing up, while fully automatic headlights adapt to changing light conditions throughout your drive. The AM/FM audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio access keeps you entertained on every journey.

Safety is built into every aspect of this Sentra, with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and an overhead airbag system protecting all occupants. Electronic stability control, traction control, and ABS brakes work together to maintain vehicle control in challenging situations. The low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about your tire conditions, contributing to overall road safety.

With its proven reliability, efficient performance, and well-appointed feature set, this 2019 Nissan Sentra SV represents a smart choice for buyers seeking a practical sedan that combines everyday utility with modern conveniences.
